key_insight: A DVAE plus particle filter can robustly monitor arc welding by learning compact weld-pool states and tracking their evolution despite noise and disturbances.
engineering_relevance: The framework aims to provide real-time, generalizable quality monitoring across different welding processes without process-specific tuning.
method: Unsupervised CNN-based DVAE learns latent weld-pool representations from images.
LSTM transition model captures time evolution under control inputs.
Particle filter tracks latent and hidden states to suppress arc radiation and reflection noise.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on both GTAW and GMAW, showing generalizability and robustness without process-specific tuning.
watch_item: Performance may depend on reliable image acquisition and careful particle-filter state design in strongly disturbed shop-floor conditions.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
